integrity_statement: The proof and finite verifier are supplied in full. Verification is same-model review only, with independent external audit not performed. No claim of authorship priority or formal certification is made.
scientific_limitations: Exact count requires one universally unit-cost chore class and private-zero chores; it does not classify general binary disutility matrices.
The two-agent parity comparison counts labeled allocations on different item universes and is not a change-in-probability assertion.
Gaussian and Stirling asymptotics hold for fixed n as the number of common chores diverges.
Priority is limited to the actually inspected sources and searchable mathematical records; possible equivalent unindexed work remains.
title: Efficient EFX allocations of binary chores: an occupancy law and a free-chore parity reversal
